description: This PHP class defines a database migration for the OrangeHRM HR management system, specifically for version 4.8.0. It includes methods to insert and update configuration records in the database, as part of the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class extending AbstractMigration that performs database insertions and updates during system upgrade to version 4.8.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by inserting configuration entries and creating a new internationalization group.

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the configuration table.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates the value of a configuration key in the database.
